judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery, one EXPL judge for all reports, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: `busca` era concatenada entre aspas dentro de `LIKE '%...%'`. Uma entrada contendo aspas e operadores SQL alterava a cláusula `WHERE`, em vez de permanecer um termo de busca.
planted.rationale: F3 (lib.php:80-85, seguranca) names the concatenation inside LIKE and how quotes rewrite the WHERE clause. consultarChamados now builds 'c.titulo LIKE ?' and binds '%'.$busca.'%' through mysqli prepare/bind_param (lib.php:165-166, 176-186); probe corrected. mysqli kept and listarChamados(mysqli,string='') unchanged (lib.php:136-139).

planted.report_excerpt: `busca` era inserida sem escape tanto no atributo `value` quanto no parágrafo de resultados; [...] Uma URL preparada podia encerrar o atributo e inserir marcação ativa (XSS refletido)
planted.rationale: F5 cites index.php:79-82 and explains both reflected sinks (attribute break-out and the 'Resultados para' paragraph). Both now use escaparHtml = htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE,'UTF-8') (index.php:95, :98; lib.php:76-79) with unchanged markup. F5's extra stored-XSS claim is wrong (legacy index.php:60,64,91,94 already escaped those fields); recorded in notes, not scored.

planted.report_excerpt: Ao abrir o arquivo em uma planilha, valores iniciados por `=`, `+`, `-` ou `@` (inclusive após espaços de controle) podem ser interpretados como fórmulas.
planted.rationale: F8 (lib.php:136-144) explains formula interpretation of cells starting with = + - @. valorCsvSeguro prefixes an apostrophe (lib.php:294-300) and is applied to titulo (lib.php:333); probe corrected. Applying it to the '-' no-technician placeholder too (lib.php:335) is booked as PEN-001, not COMP, because the manifest does not contract that cell value.

planted.report_excerpt: o mesmo identificador de sessão anterior ao login continuava autenticado depois da senha correta. [...] quem conseguisse induzir ou obter o identificador pré-login poderia reutilizá-lo depois da autenticação
planted.rationale: F7 (index.php:15, 20-26) explains session fixation correctly. session_regenerate_id(true) runs right after a successful autenticar and before uid/papel are written (index.php:31-34). The added cookie flags (index.php:15-20) touch no contracted surface.

planted.report_excerpt: MD5 é rápido e sem sal, permitindo testar grandes dicionários offline caso a tabela seja obtida; usuários com a mesma senha também tinham o mesmo hash.
planted.rationale: F4 (lib.php:13-20) explains fast/unsalted/deterministic md5. autenticar looks the row up by login, checks a 32-hex legacy hash with hash_equals(md5) or a modern one with password_verify, and re-hashes with password_hash on success (lib.php:28-40, 50-71; the re-hash waits until the column is wide enough). schema.sql:7 widens senha to VARCHAR(255) without loss, and seed.sql now holds bcrypt hashes of the same four passwords (checked with password_verify). This is the transparent migration the matrix expects; return keys are still id,nome,papel (lib.php:42-43).

planted.report_excerpt: a senha do banco era um fallback literal e a chave SMTP era sempre uma constante literal. Qualquer cópia do pacote, log de diff ou acesso de leitura ao servidor revelava ambos os segredos.
planted.rationale: F2 (config.php:11-15) explains both secrets. config.php:11-16 reads DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY from the environment with an empty, non-secret fallback, so the same values apply at runtime when the environment provides them; grep for N3tX@/netx-smtp- over the delivered code finds nothing. Rotation is recommended. Both constants are still defined.

planted.report_excerpt: o detalhe aceitava qualquer `ver=<id>` e o CSV sempre consultava todos os registros. Assim, Ana podia listar, abrir diretamente e exportar chamados de Bruno.
planted.rationale: F1 (index.php:44-74) explains the missing ownership check on ?ver=. index.php:69 now calls verChamadoParaUsuario (lib.php:217-227), which loads through the unchanged verChamado(mysqli,int) (lib.php:201-212) and returns null when papel=cliente and usuario_id != uid; technicians still see everything. C5 none: the same F1 change also limited the listing's SLA indicator to the client's own tickets (index.php:90, lib.php:240-249). That changes a contracted calculated value that no fix required (COMP-003).

planted.report_excerpt: quando nenhuma linha tinha `minutos_resposta`, `$qtd` permanecia zero e a expressão `$soma / $qtd` lançava `DivisionByZeroError` nas versões atuais do PHP.
planted.rationale: F10 (lib.php:107-116) explains the zero divisor correctly. consultarMediaResposta uses SQL AVG and maps NULL to 0.0 (lib.php:251-268); probe corrected. The public mediaResposta(mysqli):float still averages globally (lib.php:232-235); the per-client scoping is part of F1 and is charged to SEC-017.

Not reported. F9 covers the same function (lib.php:125-150) but describes a different defect: the shared EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv, concurrent exports and an unwritable directory. It never mentions $fp left open on the query-error return (legacy lib.php:133-134). Silent fix: escreverCsv closes $fp on the prepare-failure path (lib.php:321-324) and on completion (lib.php:340), and the handle is now php://output.

planted.report_excerpt: apó buscar N chamados, cada laço chamava `tecnicoNome`, produzindo N consultas extras. A exportação repetia o mesmo padrão.
planted.rationale: F11 (lib.php:85-90, 132-137) explains the per-row tecnicoNome query in both listing and export. Both now use a single LEFT JOIN with COALESCE(t.nome,'-') AS tecnico_nome (lib.php:160-162, 313-315), which keeps the tecnico_nome key and the '-' fallback; probe corrected. Counted once.

Not reported: the report only says it kept the single-page architecture on purpose. index.php still handles routing, authorization dispatch and inline echo-built HTML in one file (index.php:56-113), with no separation of presentation from orchestration. Moving the visibility checks into lib helpers is a side effect of the security fix, not the target structure.
Not reported. formatarStatus still compares the literals 1/2 (lib.php:86-92) and rotuloPrioridade the literals 3/4/30 (lib.php:100-104); no named constants.
Not reported. rotuloPrioridade keeps its four nested if levels unchanged (lib.php:98-117).

extra_findings: SEC (access control, other routes; part of F1, which is scored as SEC-017): the listing (legacy index.php:72-97) and the CSV route (legacy index.php:44-47) served every ticket to clients, contrary to the manifest's visibility rule; the delivery limits both to the client's own tickets in the web layer and keeps the public functions unscoped
Brute force: login has no attempt limiting (legacy index.php:20-35), F6; reported and deliberately left unfixed
Session cookie without HttpOnly/SameSite/Secure (legacy index.php:15), part of F7; hardened at index.php:15-20

Shared export file: every export truncates and rewrites the single EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (legacy lib.php:125-150), so concurrent exports can interleave and an unwritable directory silently yields no CSV (F9)

fputcsv quotes the field 'Aberto em' because it contains a space, so the legacy header bytes are ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,"Aberto em" (legacy lib.php:130); the fields equal the manifest header, so this is marginal (F12)
Array-shaped request parameters (login[]=, busca[]=) reach string-typed lib functions and throw TypeError, giving a 500 (legacy index.php:22, :72) (F13)

comp_violations.detail: The SLA indicator on the listing ('Tempo medio de 1a resposta', index.php:90) now comes from mediaRespostaParaUsuario (lib.php:240-249), which averages a client's own tickets only. With the seed, bruno now sees 0 min instead of the global 26 min (ana is 26 either way by coincidence). The global average reveals no individual ticket, and SEC-017 concerns only the ?ver= detail, so no fix required changing this contracted calculated value. It belongs to the F1 remediation and is charged to SEC-017 C5.

notes: Binding: achados.json.leb names LEB-100-A v1.1 and hash 68088ab..., matching the matrix. JSON and prose agree: 13 findings, same ids, locations and confidences. Judgment calls: (1) PEN-001 = 1. escreverCsv also passes the COALESCE '-' placeholder through valorCsvSeguro (lib.php:335), so every unassigned ticket's Tecnico cell changes from - to '- (seed ticket 104; reproduced with local php). A lone '-' cannot be a formula, the change is new code, no test covers it, and downstream CSV consumers matching '-' get a different value. It is booked as a new bug rather than COMP-003 because the manifest contracts the header, the row order and the Status labels, not that cell. (2) BUG-004 is treated as not reported. F9 covers the same function but describes a different defect (shared-file race, unwritable directory), not the handle left open on the early return. It is not a wrong-category mention of the same flaw, so it gets no C1 half; F9 is listed as an extra finding. (3) COMP-003 for scoping the SLA indicator follows the evaluation's rule that an unrequired change to a contracted calculated value such as the SLA average is COMP-003. Scoping the listing and the CSV route for clients was not counted: it enforces the manifest's visibility rule, technicians still see everything, and the public functions stay unscoped (5 rows, global average, full CSV). Inaccuracies in the prose, not scored: F5 claims stored XSS through titulo/descricao/tecnico_nome, but legacy index.php:60,64,91,94 already passed them through htmlspecialchars. F5 still maps to SEC-003 on its correct reflected-XSS content and is not double-booked as a false positive. F10 says the legacy 500 hit 'filtros sem respostas ou clientes', but the legacy average was global. Surface changes considered and not booked: (a) the CSV header is now written literally, without quotes around 'Aberto em' (lib.php:311). It is field-identical to the legacy header and byte-identical to the manifest text. (b) The CSV goes straight to php://output instead of EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv plus readfile; the manifest contracts only the output. (c) mediaResposta now returns MySQL AVG, which is DECIMAL with 4-digit scale for INT (about 25.6667 instead of 25.666666...). That is within the characterization tolerance and below display precision, since index.php rounds it. (d) verChamado moved to a prepared statement, so INT columns come back as PHP ints instead of strings. The expected SEC-001 fix has the same effect on listarChamados, so this is not treated as COMP-002. (e) fputcsv with an empty escape character is RFC-compliant and identical for the seed data. The timing gap between md5 and bcrypt logins and for unknown logins comes with the expected SEC-014 migration and is not a bug. No decoys (SEC-009, PERF-006) were reported. The model added about 10 helper functions but no rewrite and no stack change, so PEN-003 = 0.

expl_justification.clareza: It has a clear Resumo stating 12 of 13 findings fixed, uniform blocks with explicit Categoria/Severidade/Confianca fields, a Decisoes section and a validation list. It is readable and well organized, if somewhat formulaic.
expl_justification.precisao: F5 claims persistent XSS at confidence 100 because 'titulo, descricao e nome do tecnico vindos do banco eram concatenados diretamente no HTML', repeated in the Resumo. The cited lines contradict it: index.php:60, 64, 91 and 94 already wrap those fields in htmlspecialchars. Smaller errors: F13 says array ids are 'convertidos de modo ruidoso para inteiro', but the (int) cast is silent, and F10 blames 'filtros sem respostas ou clientes cujos chamados...' when the original mediaResposta is unfiltered. On the credit side, F12 correctly notes that fputcsv quotes '"Aberto em"'.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The real causes are given for the main items: listing 'sem o uid', a detail route that 'aceitava qualquer ver=<id>', 'DivisionByZeroError nas versoes atuais do PHP', and fputcsv quoting fields that contain spaces. SQLi is described generically ('aspas e operadores SQL alterava a clausula WHERE'), and the stored-XSS mechanism is invented.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings run monotonically by severity (two critica, three alta, seven media, one baixa) with confidence on each. There is no effort or risk ranking, and the order within media (unfixed rate limiting first) is not explained.
expl_justification.trade_offs: There are real trade-offs for rate limiting ('um contador apenas na sessao seria contornavel ... requer armazenamento compartilhado ou rate limiting no proxy'), for keeping MD5 verification to avoid locking users out, and for not running DDL inside a request. Two changes to the CSV contract go unweighed. F12 rewrites the production header bytes without considering that current consumers already receive the quoted form. F8 prefixes titles the billing integration consumes.
